name: Lithium Americas Corp.
blurb: Lithium Americas is developing the Thacker Pass lithium deposit in Humboldt County, Nevada — one of the largest known lithium clay deposits in the world, with an estimated resource of roughly 21 million tonnes of lithium carbonate equivalent. General Motors holds a minority stake and has committed to offtake. In October 2025 the U.S. Department of Energy's Loan Programs Office renegotiated a $2.23 billion construction loan into a structure that includes a 5% warrant-based equity stake for the federal government, making Washington a direct participant in domestic lithium production ahead of anticipated EV battery demand.
recent: Construction at Thacker Pass advanced through 2025 but the project remains years from first production, with no revenue expected before late this decade. The stock rallied roughly 69% in the second half of 2025 as government backing solidified and lithium spot prices rebounded. LAC carries heavy capital expenditure obligations and negative earnings through at least 2026; the investment thesis is a long-duration bet on domestic battery-material policy rather than near-term cash flow.
